name: autotester
description: Runs the 'Example execution N' transcripts in a program's docstring or header comment and shows every mismatch inline, with a diagnosis of what kind of mistake it is. Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript, Rust and Ruby.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Autotester runs the Python programs it tests.

commands.title: Autotester: Test Every File in the Workspace

autotester.script.markdownDescription: Path to `autotester.py`. Empty: the copy bundled with the extension, else `autotester.py` in the workspace folder.

autotester.python.markdownDescription: Interpreter used to run `autotester.py` itself and any Python programs. Empty: the interpreter selected in the Python extension, else `python3`.

autotester.args.markdownDescription: Extra flags passed to `autotester.py`, e.g. `["--strict"]` or `["-t", "10"]`.

autotester.inputMarker.markdownDescription: Regex marking typed input in an example line. Empty: an arrow such as `-> `. Transcripts in the `Prompt: value` style want `: `. An `autotester.json` next to the program wins over this.
